Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
18th October 1913

Sir,
A meeting of the members of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce was arranged to be held on the 17th inst at the Guild on North Honan Road. They were to meet four representatives of the Rebel party to discuss ways and means to raise further funds for repatriation purposes. About 80 rebels came on the scene and as the majority of them had no standing the meeting was not held but, after much talk, a few of the leaders were interviewed by Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿, Tsu Pau San 朱葆三 Sung Li Paung 沈聯芳 and Koo Shung Yih 顧馨一 all prominent business men who promised to communicate with Peking about the matter and also to ask General Yang to postpone the date for the distribution of the repatriation funds. It appears that this decision was not reached until threats of making trouble had been made by the rebels present. A committee meeting of the Chamber will be held to-day at 2 p.m.
The rebels hold another meeting at 71 Pau Kong Lee 宝康里 Frenchtown at 8 p.m. on the 17th inst. They all decided not to present themselves on the date for the payment of repatriation funds and to refuse to participate in the distribution until the fund was put on a more liberal financial basis.
A regiment of the 4th Division now stationed at Loongwha will be transferred to Sungkiang to-day while a regiment from Sungkiang will come to Loongwha.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）
1913年10月18日

先生：
华商总会成员会议原定于本月17日在北河南路的会馆举行。他们将会晤革命党方面的四名代表，商讨为遣返事宜筹集更多资金的方法与途径。约有80名革命党人到场，但由于其中大多数人并无地位，会议未能召开；经过多方交谈后，虞洽卿、朱葆三、沈聯芳和顧馨一这几位知名商人接见了几位首领，并承诺就此事与北京方面联络，同时请求杨将军推迟发放遣返资金的日期。看来，这一决定是在在场的革命党人发出闹事威胁后才达成的。华商总会委员会将于今日下午2时召开会议。
革命党人于本月17日晚8时在法租界宝康里71号另举行了一次会议。他们一致决定，在发放遣返资金之日不出面，并在资金基础未变得更加宽裕之前，拒绝参与分配。
现驻龙华的第四师的一个团将于今日调往松江，而松江的一个团将调来龙华。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

警务处总监上尉
